records: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. is officially branded SBIC East Japan; do not confuse it with SBI Holdings or SBI VC Trade. The official profile lists Nagoya and Osaka as sister companies but does not establish a parent/subsidiary relationship with SBI Holdings.

No direct XRP, Ripple, Circle, stablecoin issuance, custody or payment-rail relationship has been identified for Tokyo SBIC East Japan in the reviewed public sources; its documented role is SME equity investment and long-term management support.

The 2026-10-31 exact-head XRP ledger validator failure was caused by one missing source record, SRC-20261031T121200Z-SBI-EAST-JAPAN-PROFILE. The validator otherwise checked 408 shards and matched the snapshot blob SHA; the new source shard is a repair, not yet verified until the next exact-head run.
